# Relay redemption conformance vectors (Phase 8 design §10.8, §13.1). One script for two replayers:
#   - relay/crates/node/tests/redeem_vectors.rs replays it against the real relay through
#     Relay::redeem_at(request, now), Relay::sweep(now) and reopening the same data directory;
#   - the Kotlin ModelRedeemRelay of the entitlement harness (slice S9) will replay it against the
#     model.
# relay_semantics.txt and its two replayers stay unchanged (RC G19). A behaviour that is not pinned
# here is not something the model may rely on.
#
# GRAMMAR
# - One operation per line. '#' starts a comment (to the end of the line). Blank lines are ignored.
# - Words are separated by spaces. The first word is the operation. Arguments are key=value words
#   (except the first argument of token and capability, which is a name).
# - "-> <expectation>" ends a line that has an outcome.
# - Names are symbols: [A-Za-z0-9_]+.
#
# Schedule
#   Every section uses the committed test Entitlement Schedule
#   (issuer/crates/entitlement/tests/fixtures/test_schedule.ghes, verified under the test schedule
#   key, the Ed25519 key from SHA-256("ghost/test/schedule-key")): issuer name ghost-issuer-test,
#   early_window_hours 24, capability_quota_bytes 268435456, access weeks 2957..2982, invite epochs
#   739..745, credit epochs 227..229. Slot table: slot 0 = onion ghost/test/relay-a and slot 1 =
#   ghost/test/relay-b from week 2957; slot 2 = ghost/test/relay-c in weeks 2957..2966 and
#   ghost/test/relay-d from week 2967. An onion label L names the service key SHA-256(L).
#
# Time
#   <time> is <week>+<s> or <week>-<s>: start(week) + s or - s seconds, where
#   start(p) = 345600 + 604800 p (Monday 00:00 UTC). A week's tokens are accepted in
#   [start(p) - 24 h, start(p + 1) + 1 h). "at <time>" sets the clock. Unlike relay_semantics.txt
#   the clock MAY move back: a stepped-back clock is one of the cases.
#
# Sections
#   relay slot=<n> onion=<label> start=<time> [key=<hex32>] [nullifiers=create|reset|existing]
#         [revoke=<week>,<week>...] [schedule=none] [-> refused]
#     starts a relay with a fresh data directory, the clock at <time>, relay key <hex32> (default
#     32 bytes 0x42) and redemption for slot n under the onion's service key. nullifiers= says how
#     the store opens (default create: a fresh directory). revoke= re-signs the schedule as seq 2
#     with those ACCESS weeks revoked. schedule=none disables redemption (slot and onion ignored).
#     "-> refused": the relay refuses to start (design §10.5); the section then has no relay.
#     Capabilities are forgotten; tokens are global to the file.
#   restart [nullifiers=existing|reset]
#     drops the relay and reopens the same data directory with the same key and schedule at the
#     current clock (default existing).
#
# Values
#   namespace <N>  SHA-256 of the ASCII name (no declaration).
#   request <R>    the first 16 bytes of SHA-256("ghost/test/request/" || R) (no declaration).
#   token <T> kind=access|invite|credit epoch=<e> [slot=<s>] signer=<kind>:<epoch>|spki:<hex> hex=<hex>
#     a pinned 354-byte token over the challenge of (kind, epoch, slot) under the test issuer name,
#     with nonce SHA-256("ghost/test/redeem-nonce/" || T) and PSS salt
#     SHA-384("ghost/test/redeem-salt/" || T), signed by the named key of the test schedule or, for
#     spki, by a key outside the schedule (its SPKI DER; token_key_id = SHA-256 of it).
#     issuer/crates/service/tests/redeem_tokens.rs re-derives every schedule-signed token.
#   token <T> from=<T0> xor=<i> [mask=<hh>]   T0 with byte i XORed with mask (default 01).
#   token <T> from=<T0> len=<n>               T0 cut to n bytes, or extended with zero bytes to n.
#
# Operations
#   redeem token=<T> ns=<N> req=<R> -> <expectation>
#     The expectation, with the capture result of the one event the replayer also checks:
#       ok cap=<C>      OK with a capability [ok]. The first ok naming C binds it; later ones must
#                       return identical bytes. The capability is v2 (98 bytes):
#                       02 || 02 (write) || N || quota(8, BE) = 268435456 || expiry(8, BE) ||
#                       serial(16) || mac(32), expiry = start(p + 1) + 3600 for the week p of the
#                       token's key, serial = HMAC-SHA256(key, "ghost/v1/cap-serial" || p(8, BE) ||
#                       nullifier)[0..16], mac = HMAC-SHA256(key, bytes 0..66), nullifier =
#                       SHA-256("ghost/v1/nullifier" || token bytes 0..98).
#       replayed        OK with REPLAYED [rejected_nullifier]
#       wrong_period    OK with WRONG_PERIOD [rejected_period]; nothing recorded
#       rejected_token  PERMISSION_DENIED [rejected_token]
#       rejected_size   INVALID_ARGUMENT [rejected_size]
#       unavailable     UNAVAILABLE [rejected_capability]
#       unimplemented   UNIMPLEMENTED [rejected_capability]
#     Every OK answer carries relay_period_id = week(now) and relay_minute = floor(now / 60).
#     The request id is only a T1 field: it is not bound, so a retry with another one is identical.
#   capability <C> hex=<hex>    C is exactly these bytes (a byte-exact pin).
#   distinct <C>,<C>,...        the named capabilities are pairwise different.
#   sweep -> ok closed=<week>|closed=none removed=<n>
#                               one relay sweep at the current clock: n nullifier rows removed,
#                               closed = the persisted closed-through period afterwards.
#   sweep -> skipped            the clock is below the sweep's high-water minute: nothing ran.
#   nullifiers -> <n>           the store holds n nullifier rows.

# TOKENS
token a1 kind=access epoch=2959 slot=1 signer=access:2959 
token a2 kind=access epoch=2959 slot=1 signer=access:2959 
token a3 kind=access epoch=2959 slot=1 signer=access:2959 
token b0 kind=access epoch=2958 slot=1 signer=access:2958 
token b1 kind=access epoch=2960 slot=1 signer=access:2960 
token c2 kind=access epoch=2957 slot=1 signer=access:2957 
token c4 kind=access epoch=2961 slot=1 signer=access:2961 
token s0 kind=access epoch=2959 slot=0 signer=access:2959 
token m1 kind=access epoch=2966 slot=2 signer=access:2966 
token m2 kind=access epoch=2967 slot=2 signer=access:2967 
token i1 kind=invite epoch=739 signer=invite:739 
token k1 kind=credit epoch=227 signer=credit:227 
token x1 kind=access epoch=2959 slot=1 signer=invite:739 
token y1 kind=access epoch=2959 slot=1 signer=access:2960 
token n1 kind=access epoch=2959 slot=1 signer=spki: 

# Derived tokens: a flipped byte in each of the five fields, token types 0x0003 and 0x0001, and
# lengths 353 and 355.
token a1t from=a1 xor=1              # token_type 0x0003
token a1u from=a1 xor=1 mask=03      # token_type 0x0001
token a1n from=a1 xor=10             # nonce
token a1c from=a1 xor=40             # challenge_digest
token a1k from=a1 xor=70             # token_key_id: no key of the schedule
token a1a from=a1 xor=200            # authenticator
token a1s from=a1 len=353
token a1l from=a1 len=355

# --- The relay of slot 1 in week 2959 (p): reuse, restart, forged, wrong kind, slot and week.
relay slot=1 onion=ghost/test/relay-b start=2959+86400
nullifiers -> 0
redeem token=a1 ns=alpha req=r1 -> ok cap=A1
redeem token=a1 ns=alpha req=r1 -> ok cap=A1        # identical retry, identical bytes
redeem token=a1 ns=alpha req=r2 -> ok cap=A1        # the request id is not bound
redeem token=a1 ns=beta req=r3 -> replayed          # another namespace
nullifiers -> 1
redeem token=a2 ns=alpha req=r4 -> ok cap=A2        # a second token, same namespace: its own serial
distinct A1,A2
nullifiers -> 2
restart                                             # identical retries survive a restart (MS-8)
redeem token=a1 ns=alpha req=r1 -> ok cap=A1
redeem token=a1 ns=beta req=r5 -> replayed
redeem token=a2 ns=alpha req=r4 -> ok cap=A2
nullifiers -> 2
redeem token=s0 ns=alpha req=r6 -> rejected_token   # a slot-0 token at the slot-1 relay
redeem token=i1 ns=alpha req=r7 -> rejected_token   # an invite-key token
redeem token=k1 ns=alpha req=r7 -> rejected_token   # a credit-key token
redeem token=x1 ns=alpha req=r7 -> rejected_token   # an ACCESS challenge under the INVITE key
redeem token=n1 ns=alpha req=r7 -> rejected_token   # a correct signature under a non-schedule key
redeem token=c2 ns=alpha req=r8 -> wrong_period     # week p - 2
redeem token=c4 ns=alpha req=r8 -> wrong_period     # week p + 2
redeem token=y1 ns=alpha req=r8 -> wrong_period     # the key's week (2960) is not open yet
redeem token=a1t ns=alpha req=r9 -> rejected_token
redeem token=a1u ns=alpha req=r9 -> rejected_token
redeem token=a1n ns=alpha req=r9 -> rejected_token
redeem token=a1c ns=alpha req=r9 -> rejected_token
redeem token=a1k ns=alpha req=r9 -> rejected_token
redeem token=a1a ns=alpha req=r9 -> rejected_token
redeem token=a1s ns=alpha req=r9 -> rejected_size
redeem token=a1l ns=alpha req=r9 -> rejected_size
nullifiers -> 2                                     # no rejected token recorded anything
# The early edge of week p + 1 (2960).
at 2960-86401
redeem token=b1 ns=alpha req=e1 -> wrong_period
at 2960-86400
redeem token=b1 ns=alpha req=e2 -> ok cap=B1
at 2960-3600
redeem token=y1 ns=alpha req=e3 -> rejected_token   # 2960 is open now: the challenge names 2959
# The late edge of week p and the sweep boundary.
at 2960+3599
sweep -> ok closed=2958 removed=0
redeem token=a3 ns=gamma req=e4 -> ok cap=A3
distinct A1,A2,A3,B1
nullifiers -> 4
at 2960+3600
redeem token=a1 ns=alpha req=r1 -> wrong_period     # the window of p closed, before any sweep
sweep -> ok closed=2959 removed=3
nullifiers -> 1
# The clock steps back into the window of p: the closed period stays refused, no sweep runs.
at 2960-60
sweep -> skipped
redeem token=a1 ns=beta req=e5 -> wrong_period      # a replay after its row was deleted
redeem token=a2 ns=alpha req=r4 -> wrong_period
redeem token=b1 ns=alpha req=e2 -> ok cap=B1        # p + 1 is open and its row is kept
restart
redeem token=a1 ns=beta req=e5 -> wrong_period      # the high-water survives a restart
sweep -> skipped
nullifiers -> 1

# --- The late edge of week 2958 at a relay started in the first hour of week 2959.
relay slot=1 onion=ghost/test/relay-b start=2959+3599
redeem token=b0 ns=alpha req=l1 -> ok cap=B0
at 2959+3600
redeem token=b0 ns=alpha req=l1 -> wrong_period

# --- Slot 2 moves from relay-c to relay-d at week 2967.
relay slot=2 onion=ghost/test/relay-c start=2966+86400
redeem token=m1 ns=alpha req=m1 -> ok cap=M1
at 2967-86400
redeem token=m2 ns=alpha req=m2 -> rejected_token   # relay-d holds slot 2 in week 2967
relay slot=2 onion=ghost/test/relay-d start=2967-3600 -> refused   # not listed in week 2966
relay slot=2 onion=ghost/test/relay-d start=2967+0
redeem token=m2 ns=alpha req=m2 -> ok cap=M2
redeem token=m1 ns=alpha req=m1 -> rejected_token   # week 2966 is still open, but was relay-c's

# --- A revoked epoch.
relay slot=1 onion=ghost/test/relay-b start=2959+86400 revoke=2959
redeem token=a1 ns=alpha req=v1 -> rejected_token
at 2960-86400
redeem token=b1 ns=alpha req=v2 -> ok cap=V1

# --- Redemption disabled.
relay start=2959+86400 schedule=none
redeem token=a1 ns=alpha req=d1 -> unimplemented

# --- Store reset (runbook O1): the periods open at the reset are refused.
relay slot=1 onion=ghost/test/relay-b start=2959+86400 nullifiers=reset
redeem token=a1 ns=alpha req=z1 -> unavailable
at 2960-86400
redeem token=b1 ns=alpha req=z2 -> ok cap=Z1
restart
redeem token=a1 ns=alpha req=z1 -> unavailable      # the refusal survives a restart
redeem token=b1 ns=alpha req=z2 -> ok cap=Z1
# A reset in the last 24 h of week 2959 also refuses week 2960.
relay slot=1 onion=ghost/test/relay-b start=2960-3600 nullifiers=reset
redeem token=a1 ns=alpha req=z3 -> unavailable
redeem token=b1 ns=alpha req=z4 -> unavailable
at 2961-86400
redeem token=c4 ns=alpha req=z5 -> ok cap=Z2

# --- Refusals to start (design §10.5).
relay slot=1 onion=ghost/test/relay-b start=2959+86400 nullifiers=existing -> refused   # no store
relay slot=1 onion=ghost/test/relay-a start=2959+86400 -> refused   # relay-a holds slot 0
relay slot=5 onion=ghost/test/relay-b start=2959+86400 -> refused   # no slot 5
relay slot=1 onion=ghost/test/relay-z start=2959+86400 -> refused   # an unlisted onion
relay slot=1 onion=ghost/test/relay-b start=2956+86400 -> refused   # before the slot's first week

# --- Byte-exact pins of two minted capabilities (relay key 32 bytes 0x42).
relay slot=1 onion=ghost/test/relay-b start=2959+86400
redeem token=a1 ns=alpha req=p1 -> ok cap=P1
redeem token=a2 ns=beta req=p2 -> ok cap=P2
capability P1 hex=02028ed3f6ad685b959ead7022518e1af76cd816f8e8ec7ccdda1ed4018e8f2223f80000000010000000000000006ab9bc1091b37243e8547e734dbd409793a914e35269506ceddeeee49d6dbbd0af192c08a630e4d055fc1b15db7e07ce2189ea66
capability P2 hex=0202f44e64e75f3948e9f73f8dfa94721c4ce8cbb4f265c4790c702b2d41cfbf27530000000010000000000000006ab9bc10d78368c6259af2e829709a5ace802f5cea61f51186283023a47a110aefa7c19ba4b4b45b244c74156698f041db81dea9
